As of August 2026, Civiqs national tracking data for President Donald Trump’s second term shows an overall job approval rating of 35%, with 59% disapproving and 6% neutral or unsure (a net approval rating of -24).  
  
Key Demographic Trends  
  
Age: Support is lowest among young voters aged 18–34 (23% approve, 70% disapprove) and ages 35–49 (28% approve, 63% disapprove). Older voters remain closely divided (46% approve, 50% disapprove among those 65+).
